front_line: The hidden assembly line behind the AI infrastructure boom
thesis: TSS is evolving from a low-margin procurement business into a higher-value AI infrastructure integrator, with systems integration and facilities management becoming increasingly impornt drivers of earnings. Its deep relationship with Dell positions the company directly in the path of rapidly expanding rack-scale AI infrastructure demand, while operating leverage could allow cash flow to grow far faster than headline revenue. If TSS becomes an increasingly entrenched assembly and integration layer for next-generation AI systems, today's small earnings base could dramatically understand its long-term value.
moat: A plausible switching-cost story that is entirely unverified, while the testable scale advantage has worked against margins for four straight years.
risks: Customer concentration on Dell is unknown; if one customer is >50% on short, non-exclusive terms, TSS captures volume but not durable value.
